description: effort-control-v1 (preregistered, 2026-10-05): plain Sonnet 5 at reasoning effort medium vs plain Sonnet 5 at the provider default effort; cost = geometric-mean ratio of tools-normalized session cost per scenario, 95% percentile CI from 10,000 scenario-cluster bootstrap resamples (seed 20261005). The first row is the confirmatory test-split endpoint (23 scenarios x 2 reps = 46 pairs); the second row is exploratory and not concurrent (different run dates, no decision rule; n_pairs counts scenario-level comparisons, 22 scenarios). Ratios below 1.0 mean the first arm is cheaper.
